entries.title: Restart the phone
entries.description: It will clear temporary system glitches.
entries.text: A restart clears temporary glitches. Press and hold the Side key and Volume down key, then tap Restart and wait for the phone to start again.
steps: Press and hold the Side key and Volume down key.
Tap Restart.
Wait for the phone to start again.

entries.title: Safe mode check
entries.description: It will find a misbehaving downloaded app.
entries.text: Safe mode turns off downloaded apps so you can see if one of them causes the problem. Press and hold the Side key, then touch and hold Power off until Safe mode appears, and tap Safe mode. If the problem stops, uninstall recently installed apps.
steps: Press and hold the Side key.
Touch and hold Power off until Safe mode appears.
Tap Safe mode.
If the problem stops, uninstall recently installed apps.

entries.title: Power saving mode
entries.description: It will limit background battery use.
entries.text: Power saving limits background activity to stretch battery life. Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, tap Battery, then turn on Power saving.
steps: Open Settings on the Galaxy phone.
Tap Battery and device care.
Tap Battery.
Turn on Power saving.

entries.title: Put apps sleeping
entries.description: It will stop idle apps draining power.
entries.text: Apps you rarely use can keep running in the background. Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, tap Battery, tap Background usage limits, then add rarely used apps to Sleeping apps.
steps: Open Settings on the Galaxy phone.
Tap Battery and device care.
Tap Battery, then Background usage limits.
Add rarely used apps to Sleeping apps.

entries.title: Adaptive brightness
entries.description: It will stop automatic brightness jumps.
entries.text: Automatic brightness changes can look like flicker. Open Settings, tap Display, then turn off Adaptive brightness and set the brightness slider manually.
steps: Open Settings on the Galaxy phone.
Tap Display.
Turn off Adaptive brightness.
Set the brightness slider manually.

entries.title: Clean camera lens
entries.description: It will remove smudges causing blur.
entries.text: Smudges on the lens make photos blurry. Wipe the camera lens gently with a soft, dry microfibre cloth and remove any case or protector covering the lens.
steps: Wipe the camera lens with a soft, dry cloth.
Remove any case or protector covering the lens.

entries.title: Clear camera cache
entries.description: It will reset stored camera app data.
entries.text: Corrupted temporary files can affect the Camera app. Open Settings, tap Apps, tap Camera, tap Storage, then tap Clear cache.
steps: Open Settings on the Galaxy phone.
Tap Apps, then Camera.
Tap Storage.
Tap Clear cache.

entries.title: Reset all settings
entries.description: It will restore default settings, keeping data.
entries.text: Reset all settings returns every setting to its default without deleting apps, photos or files. Open Settings, tap General management, tap Reset, then tap Reset all settings and confirm.
steps: Open Settings on the Galaxy phone.
Tap General management.
Tap Reset.
Tap Reset all settings and confirm.

entries.title: Free up storage
entries.description: It will clear space before storage fills.
entries.text: When storage is nearly full the phone slows down and apps can crash. Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, tap Storage, then review large files, duplicate files and unused apps and delete what you do not need.
steps: Open Settings on the Galaxy phone.
Tap Battery and device care.
Tap Storage.
Review large files, duplicate files and unused apps.
